readings.title: Be Strong and Courageous
readings.subtitle: The Command to Possess the Land
readings.text: [Joshua 1:1] And it came to be after the death of Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Yehoshua son of Nun, the assistant of Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Mosheh <dn>My</dn> servant is dead. And now, arise, pass over this Yarden, you and all this people, to the land which <dn>I</dn> am giving to them, to the children of Yisra’el.</dq> [3] <dq>“Every place on which the sole of your foot treads, <dn>I</dn> have given you, as <dn>I</dn> spoke to Mosheh.</dq> [4] <dq>“From the wilderness and this Lebanono even as far as the great river, the River Perath, all the land of the Ḥittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, is your border.</dq> [5] <dq>“No man shall stand before you all the days of your life. As <dn>I</dn> was with Mosheh, so <dn>I</dn> am with you. <dn>I</dn> do not fail you nor forsake you.</dq> [6] <dq>“Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which <dn>I</dn> swore to their fathers to give them.</dq> [7] <dq>“Only be strong and very courageous, to guard to do according to all the Torah which Mosheh <dn>My</dn> servant commanded you. Do not turn from it right or left, so that you act wisely wherever you go.</dq> [8] <dq>“Do not let this Book of the Torah depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you guard to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and act wisely.</dq> [9] <dq>“Have <dn>I</dn> not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid, nor be discouraged, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is with you wherever you go.”</dq>

readings.title: Preparation for Crossing
readings.subtitle: The Unity of the Tribes
readings.text: [Joshua 1:10] And Yehoshua commanded the officers of the people, saying, [11] “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food for yourselves, for within three days you are passing over this Yarden, to go in to possess the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you to possess.’ ” [12] And to the Re’uḇenite, and to the Gadite, and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, Yehoshua spoke, saying, [13] “Remember the word which Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded you, saying, ‘<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you rest, and has given you this land.’ [14] “Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock stay in the land which Mosheh gave you beyond the Yarden. But you, all the mighty men of valour, shall pass over before your brothers, armed, and help them, [15] until <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gives rest to your brothers as to you, and they also take possession of the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave you beyond the Yarden toward the rising of the sun.” [16] And they answered Yehoshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we do, and wherever you send us we go. [17] “According to all that we obeyed Mosheh, so we obey you. Only let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> be with you, as <dn>He</dn> was with Mosheh. [18] “Anyone who rebels against your mouth and does not obey your words in all that you command him is put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

readings.title: Rahab and the Spies
readings.subtitle: Faith in Jericho
readings.text: [Joshua 2:1] And Yehoshua son of Nun secretly sent out two men from Shittim to spy, saying, “Go, see the land, and Yeriḥo.” And they went and came to the house of a woman, a whore whose name was Raḥaḇ, and lodged there. [2] And it was reported to the sovereign of Yeriḥo, saying, “Look, men have come here tonight from the children of Yisra’el to search out the land.” [3] And the sovereign of Yeriḥo sent to Raḥaḇ, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to search out all the land.” [4] But the woman took the two men and hid them. And she said, “It is true, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from. [5] “And it came to be as the gate was being shut, when it was dark, that the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you shall overtake them.” [6] But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order on the roof. [7] And the men pursued them by the way of the Yarden, to the fords. And as soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate. [8] And before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof, [9] and said to the men, “I know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given you the land, and that the dread of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt because of you. [10] “For we have heard how <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> dried up the water of the Sea of Reeds for you when you came out of Mitsrayim, and what you did to the two sovereigns of the Amorites who were beyond the Yarden, Siḥon and Og, whom you put under the ban. [11] “And when we heard, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in anyone because of you, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>He</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn> in the heavens above and on earth beneath. [12] “And now, please swear to me by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, since I have shown you kindness, that you also show kindness to my father’s house, and give me a true token, [13] and shall save alive my father and my mother, and my brothers and my sisters, and all that they have, and shall deliver our lives from death.” [14] And the men said to her, “Our lives for yours, if you do not report this business of ours. And it shall be, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gives us the land, that we shall treat you in kindness and truth.”

readings.title: The Oath of Safety
readings.subtitle: The Scarlet Cord
readings.text: [Joshua 2:15] And she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall, and she dwelt on the wall. [16] And she said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you. And hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned, and afterward go your way.” [17] And the men said to her, “We are released from this oath of yours which you have made us swear, [18] unless, when we come into the land, you bind this line of scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you bring your father, and your mother, and your brothers, and all your father’s household to your own house. [19] “And it shall be that anyone who goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood is on his own head, and we are innocent. And anyone who is with you in the house, his blood is on our head if a hand is laid on him. [20] “And if you report this business of ours, then we shall be released from your oath which you have made us swear.” [21] And she said, “According to your words, so be it.” And she sent them away, and they went. And she bound the scarlet cord in the window. [22] And they went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. And the pursuers sought them in all the way, but did not find them. [23] Then the two men returned and came down from the mountain, and passed over. And they came to Yehoshua son of Nun, and related to him all that befell them. [24] And they said to Yehoshua, “Truly <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given all the land into our hands, and also, all the inhabitants of the land have melted because of us.”
